<!-- The head: what the PO reads, in plain language. It must make sense without reading other tickets, and has no open question when the ticket goes to Ready. -->
### Question to answer
<!-- The specific question this spike should resolve, and which decision depends on the answer. Phrase it so the answer is a yes/no, a choice, or a number. -->

### Bound
<!-- What limits this spike: a time box (e.g. 2 days) or a fixed scope (e.g. run up to five benchmarks across three tools, then report a recommendation). It is the cost the PO accepts. Report back when the bound is reached, even if the question isn't fully answered. -->

### Acceptance criteria
<!-- Checkboxes. What a useful answer looks like, in plain words. The outcome itself goes in the conclusion comment, not here. -->
- [ ]

### Out of scope
<!-- What this spike will not do. If another ticket or step covers it, name it. -->

### Approach
<!-- How you plan to investigate: prototype, benchmark, reading, interviews, etc. -->

### Context
<!-- How this relates to other tickets (its parent, the steps before and after it, what blocks it, the siblings it builds on), the current situation, and links to earlier decisions, including the decision document. -->

### Notes
<!-- Links, prior art, risks. Omit if not applicable. -->
